text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Adenocarcinoma with Left Ovarian Metastasis.

The ultrasound confirms a thickened endometrial stripe and an adnexal mass, and the biopsy results are definitive for well-differentiated adenocarcinoma. Given the increased Inhibin B levels and the presence of an adnexal mass in a postmenopausal woman, this is consistent with metastatic ovarian cancer or a primary ovarian malignancy with uterine involvement. I will proceed with staging workup including a CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis.
